checks.check: name is "brain cloud"
schedule cron 0 8 * * * (04:00 America/New_York in EDT)
the cron comment names the DST drift
workflow_dispatch input wallMinutes defaults to "55"
workflow_dispatch input relay defaults to "false"
permissions contents read, actions write
concurrency group brain-cloud, cancel-in-progress false
job timeout-minutes 350
checkout is the first step
the STOP check comes right after checkout, before the restore and the build
the STOP check prints "stopped by state-cloud/STOP" and exits 0
every step after the STOP check is gated on BRAIN_STOP
cache restore: path state-cloud/, key brain-state-${{ github.run_number }}, restore-keys brain-state-
cache save uses the same key and waits for a checkpoint
docker run with compose.yaml caps
BRAIN_EPISODES_MAX read from the Dockerfile
a poll loop GETs /health every 60 s into health.log
a crash loop ends the poll early and fails the run, and is never relayed
the ladder step probes the model endpoint on the runner and prints what it found
stopped with SIGINT (docker stop --time 60, --stop-signal SIGINT)
the ladder runs through tools/budget.mjs on a scheduled run, into ladder.log
the job summary carries the table
artifacts uploaded with retention 90 days
the store upload is optional and never fails the job
the relay is the last step and runs only with relay true
secrets appear only as ${{ secrets.NAME }} references
no em-dash
